_readme: Two ways to connect a client to this MCP server:
OPTION A — HTTP (one shared server, many projects):
1. Start the server once:  python -m src.server
2. Each project points at the SAME url and sends its own
project's own .env for every request. The server's own .env is
3. Adding a new project requires zero changes to the MCP server —
just point a new client entry at the same url with its own
OPTION B — stdio (client spawns one process per project):
Set 'cwd' (or REPO_ROOT) to the project root; the server loads
that project's .env the same way, no X-Project-Root header needed.
